value.rationale: A natural multiplicative invariant of the local-operator family: exact nonclosed semigroup of products, irreducible algebraic envelope with explicit defining equations, n-r-2 components each of dimension n+2, and universal affine (n+1)-dimensional intersections. This describes a genuine dimension jump from published individual-operator strata and connects evolution algebra structure to a precise family of toric degenerations, rather than a routine rename or arbitrary finite slice.
